colonias_siapa.pdf.comment: SIAPA's 13 Oct 2026 reissue (23 pages) with truncated columns (zone 6 Tlaquepaque/Zapopan). api/data/colonias.json comes from the 12 Oct PDF (34 pages, 621 colonias); don't regenerate it from this file.

ajustes.php.comment: The cut days per zone and hand-made colonia zone changes SIAPA edits from its /admin panel (last saved 16 Oct 2026); the page's calendar module (assets/calendario-*.js) fetches it with no-store, so index.html doesn't change when the days do. Its sha256 leaves out «actualizado».

rotacion-siapa.topo.json.comment: The map SIAPA's page draws since 16 Oct 2026 (colonias with the zones SIAPA gives them, and the 7 zone polygons); web/colonias_siapa.topo.json and the bot's zone lookup are built from it by pipelines/siapa_mapa.py.
